snippet.title: MAG™ Escalation Trailer
snippet.description: For the first time, all 3 PMCs will fight for control of a single battlefield on 3 brand new maps! Featuring epic 96 player battles with multiple objectives per round, plus 9 additional weapons and armor, all with new metals, ribbons and trophies, the Escalation Mission Pack provides the most competitive and intense MAG combat to date. Escalation is $9.99 and available for download on the PlayStation Store.
